external_entities.name: member
external_entities.description: A grocery loyalty programme member who uses the mobile app and connects partner apps.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Members collect points when they shop

external_entities.name: browser
external_entities.description: A browser used for authorization-server sign-in, consent, and redirect handling.
external_entities.source_excerpt: signs in on the authorization server's sign-in page in their browser

external_entities.name: partner app
external_entities.description: A web application operated by another company on its own server.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Partner apps are web applications that other companies run on their own servers

processes.name: mobile app
processes.description: The mobile application through which members sign in, call the rewards API, and manage connected partner apps.
processes.notes: The app retains a mobile refresh token. PKCE challenge usage is not recorded.

processes.name: authorization server
processes.description: The authorization server that authenticates members, handles authorization-code flows and consent, and issues tokens.
processes.source_excerpt: The app signs a member in through our authorization server with the authorization code flow
processes.notes: The authorization server signs tokens for the support console with the same key.

processes.name: rewards API
processes.description: The API called by mobile and partner applications to read and write loyalty points and redeem points for gift cards.
processes.source_excerpt: The rewards API reads and writes the points ledger
processes.notes: The API does not check which client or audience an access token was issued for.

processes.name: support console
processes.description: A web application that closes member accounts.
processes.source_excerpt: The support console is a web app that closes a member's account.
processes.notes: It uses access tokens from the same authorization server and shares a public hostname with the rewards API.

data_stores.name: identity database
data_stores.description: Database holding member accounts, email addresses, password hashes, authorization codes, refresh tokens, and consents.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The authorization server keeps member accounts, email addresses and password hashes in the identity database
data_stores.notes: Refresh tokens remain in the database when an account is closed. Protection at rest is not recorded.

data_stores.name: points ledger
data_stores.description: Ledger holding every member's balance and every points transaction.
data_stores.source_excerpt: the points ledger, which holds every member's balance and every points transaction
data_stores.notes: The ledger records which client made each change, but not which member approved it.

data_stores.name: API log store
data_stores.description: Store receiving every rewards API request, including headers.
data_stores.source_excerpt: writes every request it receives, headers included, to the API log store
data_stores.notes: Protection at rest is not recorded.

data_flows.name: use app
data_flows.description: A member uses the mobile app.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Members use our mobile app.
data_flows.notes: unknown
data_flows.data_description: Member interaction with the mobile app

data_flows.name: sign in
data_flows.description: The mobile app signs the member in through the authorization server.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The app signs a member in through our authorization server with the authorization code flow
data_flows.notes: PKCE challenge usage is not recorded.

data_flows.name: call API
data_flows.description: The mobile app calls the rewards API with an access token.
data_flows.source_excerpt: then calls the rewards API with the access token it gets back
data_flows.notes: Access tokens are plain bearer tokens.
data_flows.data_description: Access token and rewards API requests

data_flows.name: disconnect app
data_flows.description: A member uses the mobile app settings screen to disconnect a partner app.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Members can disconnect a partner app from the settings screen of the mobile app
data_flows.notes: unknown

data_flows.name: sign in
data_flows.description: The browser submits member sign-in and consent interactions to the authorization server.
data_flows.source_excerpt: signs in on the authorization server's sign-in page in their browser and approves a consent screen
data_flows.notes: The authorization-server sign-in is retained in a cookie for thirty days; idle timeout is not decided.
data_flows.data_description: Sign-in credentials, consent, and authorization-session cookie

data_flows.name: return code
data_flows.description: The browser returns to the partner app's redirect URI with an authorization code.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The browser then returns to the partner app's redirect URI with an authorization code.
data_flows.notes: The authorization code stays valid for ten minutes.

data_flows.name: request token
data_flows.description: A partner app sends token requests containing its client secret to the authorization server.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The partner app sends that secret in the body of its token requests.
data_flows.notes: The client secret is sent in the request body.
data_flows.data_description: Client ID, client secret, authorization code, and token request

data_flows.name: show points
data_flows.description: A partner app accesses the rewards API to show a member's points.
data_flows.source_excerpt: a meal-planning service that shows a member's points
data_flows.notes: The source describes the partner app as showing points but does not explicitly describe its API call.

data_flows.name: update points
data_flows.description: The rewards API reads and writes the points ledger.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The rewards API reads and writes the points ledger
data_flows.notes: unknown

data_flows.name: write requests
data_flows.description: The rewards API writes every received request and its headers to the API log store.
data_flows.source_excerpt: writes every request it receives, headers included, to the API log store
data_flows.notes: unknown

data_flows.name: use console
data_flows.description: A browser accesses the support console.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The support console is a web app that closes a member's account.
data_flows.notes: The source does not explicitly identify the browser user.

data_flows.name: close account
data_flows.description: The support console marks a member account closed in the identity database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Closing an account marks it closed in the identity database.
data_flows.notes: Existing refresh tokens are not removed.

data_flows.name: store identity data
data_flows.description: The authorization server stores member identity and authorization data in the identity database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The authorization server keeps member accounts, email addresses and password hashes in the identity database, together with the authorization codes, refresh tokens and consents it issues.
data_flows.notes: unknown
data_flows.data_description: Member accounts, email addresses, password hashes, authorization codes, refresh tokens, and consents

trust_boundaries.name: own cloud account
trust_boundaries.description: The organisation's cloud account where the authorization server, rewards API, support console, and data stores run.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Everything below runs in our own cloud account
trust_boundaries.notes: The source does not describe internal network segmentation.

trust_boundaries.name: members' phones
trust_boundaries.description: Members' phones, outside the organisation's cloud account, where the mobile app runs and refresh tokens are kept.

trust_boundaries.name: partner app server
trust_boundaries.description: Servers operated by other companies that run partner apps.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: partner apps that other companies run on their own servers

assumptions.basis: The rewards API is served on a public hostname.
The support console is served on the same public hostname as the rewards API.

assumptions.assumption: The identity database contains confidential data.
assumptions.basis: It holds member accounts, email addresses, password hashes, authorization codes, refresh tokens, and consents.

assumptions.assumption: The points ledger contains confidential data.
assumptions.basis: It holds every member's balance and every points transaction.

assumptions.assumption: The API log store contains confidential data.
assumptions.basis: It holds every request received by the API, including headers, which may contain bearer credentials and member-related request data.
